prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: an isolated conceptual illustration component for a Chinese semiconductor engineering report, not a technical diagram. Input image 1 is only a reference for the restrained navy, teal, white palette and clean professional mood; do not reproduce its text or boxes. Create one elegant firmware file object, a substantial white folded document standing at a very slight isometric angle, with a small embossed navy microchip motif and three faint teal horizontal code marks, subtle paper depth, extremely restrained engineering-whitepaper rendering. Fully transparent background. Centered, generous clear margins, nearly front-on so it will fit into an exact typeset process figure. There must be no text, no letters, no numbers, no logo, no arrows, no state transitions, no invented data. This is a visual metaphor for a boot firmware file; the exact relations and all labels will be composed separately with verified fonts. Avoid glossy product advertisement styling, dramatic shadows, gradients filling the canvas, decorative circuitry outside the object, or card layouts.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: isolated component illustration for a semiconductor verification report; not a technical diagram. Input image 1 is a palette/style reference only: white page, muted navy outlines and teal accents. Create a single EMPTY shallow rectangular hardware processing tray, wide 2.5-to-1 footprint, viewed almost front-on with very slight isometric depth. Pale cool gray ceramic body, crisp thin navy outline, small restrained teal edge accent, an open blank interior large enough for an independently typeset transaction token. Transparent background, no surrounding scene, centered object with small equal margins. This visual component will be repeated and combined by deterministic typesetting to represent exact P/R states, so draw only one tray and no content. No text, letters, numbers, arrows, state sequence, logos, ticks, crosses, diagram grid, or status lights. Professional technical illustration, readable at small report size, restrained semi-flat illustration rather than glossy 3D advertising.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: isolated conceptual illustration component for a processor differential-verification report. Input image 1 is only a reference for its navy/teal/white professional palette. Create a clean small processor chip beside a plain folded program document, treated as ONE compact grouped object. Matte white ceramic chip with thin navy pins and a modest teal inset, paper document with a few faint unlabeled gray lines. Almost front-on, very slight isometric depth, balanced calm technical-whitepaper styling. Transparent background. This is a conceptual common DUT/program illustration above an exact comparison graphic; it must contain no technical result or data. No text, letters, numbers, arrows, badges, checks, crosses, damaged parts, gauges, fake code, logo or watermark. Do not depict a repair or a failure; both independent experiments use the same undamaged object. Keep high clarity and generous negative space around the object.
